title: Past the teacher
goals: Reach the mark in the bottom arch.
Do not let Dask see you.
starting_code:
# Walk down to the cell before the crossing with `move_down`.

# Wait while Dask faces right, with `while`, `facing` and `wait`.

# Walk on down.
hints: Dask's lantern shines far! Walk 5 down to stop just before the crossing.
Use `while` with `dask.facing` to wait until he looks away.
When he turns around, walk 7 down to the arch!
intro: It's Dask again! His lantern shines a long way down the corridor. We are headed for the mark in the bottom arch, but we must cross his path. We don't know how long he will look this way, so no fixed number of waits will work! We need to walk to the cell right before the crossing and wait while he faces right.
outro: We did it! Waiting until he turns is the only way to be safe.
learned: Now you know that `while` waits as long as something stays true, however long that is.

ways.near: Dask has just begun his round
ways.middle: Dask has nearly ended his round
ways.far: Dask is on his way back
